sloka: एवम् सीताम् तदा दृष्ट्वा हृष्टः पवन सम्भवः ।जगाम मनसा रामम् प्रशशम्स च तम् प्रभुम् ॥५-१५-५४॥
transliteration: evam sītām tadā dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭaḥ pavana sambhavaḥ ।jagāma manasā rāmam praśaśamsa ca tam prabhum ॥5-15-54॥

translations.english: "Rama, the strongarmed hero has accomplished a difficult task by surviving even for a moment without this Sita who has intoxicating lustre".
